name: haystack

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for OpenAI-backed generators / embedders.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed generators.

PIPELINE_DIR.description: Directory of Haystack pipeline YAML files. Each YAML is exposed as a named pipeline. Defaults to ./pipelines.

DOCUMENT_STORE_URL.description: Connection string for a persistent document store (e.g. Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate). Defaults to in-memory.

notes: deepset's RAG pipeline framework — runs user-authored YAML pipelines. ADVISOR tier because pipelines are operator-defined; per-component side effects bound by the wired components. Trust floor moderate to allow tool-augmented generators to act.
